name: io.github.NeuralNexusNote/n3mc-workingmemory
title: N3MemoryCore Lite (Working Memory)
description: Ephemeral (7-day TTL) hybrid vector + BM25 memory MCP server backed by Redis Stack. Multilingual out of the box (NFKC + CJK / Hangul / Thai / Lao / Myanmar / Khmer bigram + diacritic fold). Designed as a working-memory layer to complement persistent memory MCPs.
